purpose: Logical healthcare capabilities. Physical hosts are configured independently.

services.description: Assesses the arriving patient: sets a priority, orders tests, and sends the patient to diagnostics or straight to treatment. Simulated, with some random variation.
services.returns: Triage results with priority CRITICAL, URGENT or STANDARD. Routes on "STANDARD_WORKFLOW" (to the diagnostic tests) or "DIRECT_TO_TREATMENT".

services.description: Runs the ordered lab tests (simulated) and flags abnormal or critical values. A stroke code gets the stroke bloods instead: INR, platelets and glucose (StrokeBloods).
services.returns: Laboratory results and a clinical summary. No routing value.

services.description: Simulates an ECG and grades the patient's cardiac risk.
services.returns: Cardiology results with risk CRITICAL, HIGH, MODERATE or LOW. No routing value.

services.description: Chooses the imaging study for the presenting complaint and writes a simulated report. A stroke code is imaged by the stroke protocol instead: CT brain and CT angiography (StrokeImaging).
services.returns: Radiology findings, impression and recommendations. No routing value.

services.description: Performs the same imaging study for another hospital and records an audit trail of the cross-facility request.
services.returns: Radiology results plus the requesting hospital and audit fields. No routing value.

services.description: Combines the lab, cardiology and radiology results into a diagnosis, a disposition and a treatment plan.
services.returns: Diagnosis results with a disposition: ICU, urgent admission, observation or outpatient follow-up. No routing value.

services.description: Gives the planned medications and procedures, judges the patient's response (simulated) and decides whether the patient can be discharged.
services.returns: Treatment results including discharge_ready. No routing value.

services.description: Treats a simple case sent straight from triage; a complex case is marked as needing a full workup.
services.returns: Treatment results with status TREATMENT_COMPLETE. No routing value.

services.description: The ambulance service's stroke screen on the road: FAST, blood glucose and time of onset decide whether to alert the stroke centre and the receiving hospital.
services.returns: Screen results carrying the patient's case. Routes on "stroke_alert" or "standard_ed" (FAST negative, glucose under 4.0 mmol/L, or onset over 24 hours).

services.description: The stroke centre holds its angiography suite and team for the stroke code, before the patient reaches hospital. Recorded against the stroke code.
Compensation: releases the suite hold of a stroke code that will not need clot retrieval. Started by the stroke code's Signal node "Stand Down Suite". Safe to repeat.
services.returns: Routes on "released" or "nothing_to_release" (no hold, or already released).

services.description: The receiving hospital's emergency department meets the ambulance: a stroke code orders CT and bloods together; resolved symptoms exclude it.
services.returns: Triage results marked as a stroke code. Routes on "stroke_code" (to imaging and pathology in parallel) or "stroke_excluded".

services.description: The telestroke neurologist at the stroke centre, once CT and bloods are both in: thrombolysis within 4.5 hours unless contraindicated (haemorrhage, blood pressure over 185/110 after treatment, INR over 1.7, platelets under 100); clot retrieval for a large-vessel occlusion within 24 hours.
Tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg (at most 25 mg) at the receiving hospital.
services.returns: Routes on "transfer" (a large-vessel occlusion: on for clot retrieval) or "lysis_only".

services.description: Clot retrieval at the stroke centre, in the held suite, straight from the neurologist's decision.
services.returns: Reperfusion graded on the eTICI scale. Routes on "retrieved".

services.description: Clot retrieval at the stroke centre after thrombolysis at the receiving hospital (drip and ship).
services.returns: Reperfusion graded on the eTICI scale. Routes on "retrieved".
